originality.rationale: The new content is only the exact finite max length 32 and ten inequivalent maximizers for ternary strict epsilon 9/10 words. Cheng et al 2018 Appendix A proves a stronger infinite critical epsilon bound 12/13, explicitly acknowledged and not re-claimed. Xu et al 2026 proves ternary existence for epsilon >226/227; neither entails the finite ten-orbit result. Earlier epsilon 7/8 finite exact census differs in objective parameter and witnesses. Camungol-Rampersad requires equal adjacent lengths instead of all splits.

No improvement to the already published stronger asymptotic 12/13 bound is claimed.
